name: Weather station
definition: instrument set that measures several weather quantities together; `sensor_suite`, `sensor_count`, `link`, `shield` and display type are attributes (C14(c)).

name: Air-quality monitor
definition: instrument that measures pollutants or particles in the air (K-147).

name: Anemometer
definition: instrument that measures wind speed.

name: Beaker
definition: wide cylindrical open vessel with a spout, for holding, mixing and heating liquids.

name: Erlenmeyer flask
definition: conical flask with a narrow neck, for mixing and heating.

name: Volumetric flask
definition: flat-bottomed flask with a long neck and a single mark, for making a solution to an exact volume.

name: Round-bottom flask
definition: round flask for heating and boiling liquids.

name: Test tube
definition: small tube closed at one end, for holding or heating a small sample.

name: Graduated cylinder
definition: tall cylinder with a volume scale, for measuring liquid volume.

name: Pipette
definition: tube for drawing up and delivering a measured amount of liquid.

name: Burette
definition: graduated tube with a tap, for delivering liquid in controlled amounts.

name: Petri dish
definition: shallow lidded dish for culturing cells or microbes.

name: Laboratory balance
definition: balance made to weigh samples in a laboratory.

name: Centrifuge
definition: machine that spins samples to separate their parts.

name: Laboratory incubator
definition: chamber that holds samples at a set warm temperature.

name: Laboratory oven
definition: oven for drying or heating samples at a set temperature.

name: Laboratory freezer
definition: freezer or ultra-low-temperature unit made for cold storage of samples (C-18; R-28 includes laboratory refrigerators).

name: Fume hood
definition: ventilated cabinet that draws fumes from work on samples away from the user (C-18).

name: Dissection set
definition: set of instruments for dissecting specimens.

name: Science experiment kit
definition: kit made to teach science through an experiment programme; `discipline` is an attribute (chemistry, physics and electricity, biology, earth and space, crystals and materials and others as sold) with a

name: Telescope eyepiece
definition: eyepiece made for a telescope.

name: Alt-azimuth mount
definition: telescope mount that moves up-down and left-right.

name: Equatorial mount
definition: telescope mount with an axis aligned to the Earth's axis for following the sky.

name: Solar filter
definition: filter made to fit a telescope or binocular for safe viewing of the Sun.

name: Astronomy imaging camera
definition: camera made only to fit a telescope (K-15).

name: Microscope slide
definition: slide made to hold a specimen under a microscope.

name: Microscope camera
definition: camera or adapter made to fit only one kind of microscope (S3 reading as in K-15).

name: Pocket microscope
definition: small handheld microscope carried in the pocket.

name: Cassegrain reflector telescope
definition: Telescope whose concave primary and convex secondary mirror fold the light back through a hole in the primary, with no full-aperture corrector plate.

name: Telescope tripod
definition: Tripod made to carry a telescope mount head, sold apart from the mount; a universal photo tripod is D4.

name: Mount counterweight
definition: Weight fitted on the counterweight shaft of a telescope mount to balance the tube.

name: Tube rings (tube clamps)
definition: Pair of rings or a clamp that holds a telescope tube on a mount dovetail.

name: Polar scope (pole finder)
definition: Small sighting scope fitted in an equatorial mount's polar axis to align it on the celestial pole.

name: Equatorial wedge
definition: Tilting plate that sets a fork or alt-az telescope mount at the latitude angle to track equatorially.

name: Eye loupe
definition: Loupe in a short tube held in the eye socket, leaving both hands free; also called watchmaker's loupe.
